app.name: KataBox
app.devDataHint: Development build: progress is saved in a separate folder, not your real data.

palette.placeholder: Type a command or search a problem…

home.title: Home
home.noDraft: No draft yet. Pick a problem to start.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.toggleResults: Show or hide tests and results

editorial.none: This problem has no editorial yet.
editorial.lockedReason: It unlocks when you solve the problem, or after {{required}} failed submissions ({{failed}}/{{required}}).
editorial.unlockedSolved: Unlocked because you solved this problem.

history.none: No snapshots yet. Every Run and Submit saves one.
history.help: Select two snapshots to compare them, or one to compare it with the editor.

script.label: Check the code as
script.hint: JS checks plain JavaScript (no type annotations needed); TS checks strict TypeScript. Run and Submit work the same either way.

heatmap.title: Activity
heatmap.label: Submissions per day over the last 12 months
heatmap.help: Use the arrow keys to move between days; Home and End jump to the first and the last day.

reviews.title: Review queue
reviews.none: No reviews scheduled. Your first Accepted on a problem schedules its review in 3 days.

settings.title: Settings

calibration.title: Judge speed
calibration.description: Time limits are set on a reference computer. KataBox measures this computer once with a short benchmark and scales every limit by the result, between ×0.5 and ×3.
calibration.notMeasured: Not measured yet: it happens on your first Run or Submit, or now.

settings.noticesIntro: KataBox includes the components below, each under its own license.
settings.noticesDev: The notices are included in release builds (generated by pnpm notices).

errors.invalid_custom_input: A custom test input is not valid.
errors.unsupported_language: This language is not supported yet.
errors.toolchain_missing: The runtime for this language is not installed.
errors.judge_busy: A run is already in progress.
errors.sandbox: The sandbox could not run the code.
errors.judge_internal: The judge failed. This is not your fault.
errors.store: The database could not be read or written.
errors.internal: KataBox could not start or hit an unexpected error.
errors.language_server_unavailable: No language server for this language here.
errors.language_server_not_connected: The language server is not running; it restarts when you type.
errors.download_failed: A download failed. Retry continues where it stopped.
errors.network_unavailable: Could not reach the download server. Check your connection and retry.
errors.host_not_allowed: A download pointed to a site KataBox does not trust, so it was stopped.
errors.checksum_mismatch: A download did not match its checksum and was discarded.
errors.size_mismatch: A download had the wrong size and was discarded.
errors.unsafe_archive: A downloaded archive contained something unsafe and was not installed.
errors.not_enough_space: There is not enough free disk space for this install.
errors.file_locked: A file is in use (an antivirus scan or a running program). Wait a moment and retry.
errors.install_busy: Another install or uninstall is running.
errors.unsupported_platform: KataBox cannot install languages on this system yet.
errors.calibration_unavailable: Measuring this computer needs Python or JavaScript/TypeScript installed.
errors.locked_in_interview: This is locked during the mock interview.
errors.interview_active: A mock interview is already running.
errors.not_enough_problems: There are fewer than two unsolved problems you have never opened.
errors.import_invalid: This file is not a valid KataBox export.
errors.debug_unsupported: This language cannot be debugged yet. Debugging is available for Python.
errors.debug_diverged: This program behaves differently on each run (time, randomness or object identity), so it cannot be replayed step by step.
errors.profile_unavailable: This problem has no complexity profile.

message.output_mismatch: The returned value differs from the expected output.
message.custom_checker_unsupported: Custom checkers are not supported yet.
message.unsupported_syntax: This TypeScript syntax is not supported.
message.compile_limit: The compiler ran out of time or memory.
message.return_not_serializable: The return value cannot be converted to JSON.
message.out_of_memory: The program ran out of memory.
message.too_much_output: The test printed too much output.
message.node_cycle: The returned list or tree links back to a node it already contains (a cycle, or a node shared by two parents).
message.time_limit: The time limit was reached during this test.
message.output_limit: The output limit was reached during this test.
message.memory_limit: The memory limit was reached during this test.
message.process_exited: The program exited or crashed during this test.
message.harness_silent: The test harness stopped without reporting.
message.bad_harness_record: The test harness reported something unreadable.

results.empty: Run or submit to see results here.

custom.needsPython: Custom inputs are checked against the problem's constraints only when Python is installed.

status.stopped: {{language}} language server: paused while idle; it resumes when you type
status.basicCompletion: basic completion of keywords and common functions

install.firstRunIntro: KataBox runs your code with its own copy of each language: downloaded once from the official sites, checked against pinned checksums, and kept inside KataBox's folder. Pick the languages you want; you can add or remove them later in Settings.

includes.python: Python 3.14, Node.js 26 and the basedpyright language server
includes.typescript: Node.js 26, TypeScript 6 and its language server
includes.rust: Rust 1.99, its standard library sources and rust-analyzer

install.uninstallHint: Its runtime and language server are removed (Node.js stays while another language needs it). Your drafts, notes and submissions are kept.
install.cancelled: Install cancelled. What was downloaded is kept: Retry continues where it stopped.
install.failed: The install did not finish. What was downloaded is kept: Retry continues where it stopped.
install.missingHint: Install it to run and submit in {{language}}.
install.licenses: Downloaded from their official sites: Python (PSF License), Node.js (MIT), PHP (PHP License), Rust and rust-analyzer (MIT or Apache-2.0), TypeScript and its language server (Apache-2.0), basedpyright (MIT).
install.unsupportedPlatform: KataBox cannot install languages on this system yet.

daily.title: Daily problem
daily.hint: A new pick every day, leaning toward your weakest pattern.

streak.label: Daily streak: {{count}}
streak.none: Solve the daily problem to start a streak.

review.title: Review
review.banner: Review: your earlier code is hidden until you pass.
review.graduated: Review passed: this problem is mastered and leaves your review queue.
review.lapsedBanner: Not this time: the review restarts at 3 days. Try again when you are ready.
review.locked: Hidden until you pass this review.

lists.name: Name
lists.deleteConfirm: “{{name}}” will be deleted. The problems stay in the library.
lists.empty: No lists yet. Create one, then add problems from the library or the workspace.
lists.emptyList: This list is empty. Add problems from the library or the workspace.
lists.reorderHint: Drag the rows, or focus one and press Alt+↑ / Alt+↓.

interview.title: Mock interview
interview.intro: Two problems you have never opened, against the clock. Hints, the editorial, your earlier attempts and solutions stay locked until the time is up or you end it.

data.title: Data
data.intro: Export your progress to one file, or import a file exported by KataBox on another computer. Import merges by problem and keeps the newer record.
data.conflicts_one: {{count}} record already exists here; the newer one will be kept.
data.conflicts_other: {{count}} records already exist here; the newer one will be kept.

debug.unsupported: Debugging is available for Python and JavaScript/TypeScript for now.
debug.busy: Wait for the current run to finish.
debug.empty: Choose "Debug this case" on a test, or press F5 to debug the first public test. Click just right of a line number, or press F9 on the cursor's line, to set a breakpoint.
debug.gutter: Breakpoints (click a line, or press F9 on the cursor's line)
debug.raised: Finished: an exception was raised at line {{line}}
debug.truncated: Stopped recording after {{count}} steps; you can still step through them.

failed.time_limit: The test hit the time limit while debugging.
failed.memory_limit: The test hit the memory limit while debugging.
failed.output_limit: The test printed too much while debugging.
failed.diverged: This program behaves differently on each run (time, randomness or object identity), so it cannot be replayed step by step.

debug.consoleHelp: Each step replays the test, so what you evaluate here never changes the program.

complexity.buttonHint: Measure how your solution's time grows with the input size
complexity.measuring: Measuring at growing sizes… (at most about 15 seconds)
complexity.title: Complexity estimate

confidence.low: Several curves fit about as well; take this one with care.

complexity.noisy: Most timings are under a millisecond, where noise dominates.
complexity.notEnough: Not enough sizes ran in time to estimate a class (at least 3 are needed).
complexity.explanation: Your solution ran on inputs of growing size n, 3 times each (the median counts), and the most common growth curves were fitted to the times. Timings vary between runs and machines, so this is an estimate, not a proof.

stopped.budget: Stopped before n = {{n}}: it would not have finished within the time budget.
stopped.time_limit: Stopped at n = {{n}}: it ran out of time.
stopped.failed: Stopped at n = {{n}}: {{verdict}}. Fix that first; no time was taken from it.

complexity.chartLabel: Log-log chart of time against input size. {{summary}}
